capabilities.purpose: Tracks per-shop ingredient, product and supply stock and flags reorder shortfalls.
Assigns drivers and vehicles and follows each delivery from pickup to drop-off.
Ingests uploaded unit price lists and procedures and answers operational questions over them.
Prices delivery runs, vehicle operating cost and products from the unit prices on file.
Consolidates sales, stock, delivery and fleet KPIs across the five bakeries.
Administers users, roles, shop assignments and driver shifts.
Turns operating procedures into daily checklists and tracks acknowledgment.
Keeps an auditable trail of stock, delivery, upload and acknowledgment events with hashes.
